name: APT
summary: Early high-level language for numerically controlled machine tools: geometry statements define points, lines, circles and surfaces, and motion statements (GO, GOFWD, TLLFT) drive a cutter relative to them; the processor produced CL data post-processed to machine codes; standardised as ISO 4342 and ANSI X3.37.

level_notes.0: No open implementation survives in maintained form.
level_notes.1: ANSI X3.37 and ISO 3592/4342 are paywalled; no open copy of the defining APT manuals is linked.
level_notes.2: Ross wrote the retrospective "Origins of the APT language" (HOPL 1978, paywalled); little other open secondary material.

resources.title: Origins of the APT Language for Automatically Programmed Tools (Ross, HOPL 1978)
